cause: Google resumable sessions were initialized server-side without the browser Origin. Google stored each file but withheld the final CORS response, so the browser reported failure and never registered the trip folder.
changes: Pass the request origin when initializing each Google Drive resumable session.
Require a returned file ID before counting an upload as confirmed.
Display the first provider or network failure while preserving failed files for retry.
Restore the verified existing folder of four uploads to the affected departure with its shared guide attribution.

checks.real_drive_transfer: Without initial Origin: browser fetch failed but file existed. With Origin: HTTP 200 and file ID. Both disposable test files deleted.
checks.original_files: All three retry folders contained the same four files, verified by MD5; originals untouched.

limits: Hosted browser checks simulated authentication, providers and messages; the independent real Drive probe exercised actual browser transfers.
No customer messages sent. Two earlier duplicate folders left untouched.
initial_deploy_attempt: Vercel returned Not authorized; read access was verified and the same release succeeded on retry.
